rust_summary: submitting bounded depth-tested world lines and full-screen tint or vignette for a client frame.
doc_summary: `draw_world_line(start, end, color, width)` submits a world-space line during a client world frame hook. Color is ARGB and width is in pixels from 0.5 to 4; each frame accepts at most 256 lines. Endpoints must be distinct and finite; lines with either endpoint farther than 256 blocks from the camera are discarded. The host depth-tests and consumes the accepted lines for that frame. `draw_post_tint(color)` and `draw_post_vignette(color)` submit at most 16 full-screen effects per frame, after the world and before the HUD. Vignette alpha controls its darkening strength. Bundles need fragment @API:world_lines@.
